properties.statement:
MEASURED 2026-08-10 by reading which edge constants each analysis module actually spans (structure.rs, flow.rs, budget.rs, hierarchy.rs, heal.rs, surprises.rs, allocate.rs, propagate.rs) and joining that against edge counts in the live export.

    populated edge types                               35   (of 61 declared — 26 are never used at all)
    types reached by ANY graph analysis                12
    types reached by NONE                              23   = 2,293 of 7,446 edges, 31%

THE GOLDEN THREAD IS IN THE UNANALYSED SET. GOVERNED_BY (867), REALIZES (199), SATISFIES (175), VERIFIES (139) — the core traceability of the whole design — have never been cycle-checked, never had centrality run on them, never been community-detected. Nor has PRECEDES (47), which IS the delivery plan. Meanwhile DEPENDS_ON (173 edges) carries FOUR separate analyses (structure, budget, hierarchy, allocate).

THE CAUSE IS WIRING, NOT CAPABILITY. Every algorithm needed is already imported from dynograph and already runs: betweenness_centrality, leiden, cut_structure, connected_components, find_cycle, strongly_connected_components. Each is nailed to one purpose-specific edge subset at its call site. Graph algorithms are edge-type agnostic; the wiring is not. Anthony's own earlier tool (/home/ajs7/reflow/tools/system_of_systems_graph.py) took the opposite shape — ONE graph built from all edges, then nx.simple_cycles and degree analysis over it — and he ran it as a routine sanity check on nearly every graph.

WHAT THE MISSING ANALYSES ACTUALLY FOUND WHEN RUN BY HAND, so the gap is not reported as hypothetical:

    GOLDEN THREAD  SATISFIES+REALIZES+VERIFIES+ALLOCATED_TO   677 edges   0 cycles
    REASONING      GOVERNED_BY+OBSOLETES+CAUSES+ANTICIPATES   893 edges   1 cycle
    THE PLAN       PRECEDES+SCHEDULED_FOR                      70 edges   0 cycles
    TIME/HISTORY   HAS_SNAPSHOT+AT_EPOCH+VALID_FROM+VALID_TO  646 edges   0 cycles
    RISK           RISKS+BLOCKS+CONTRADICTS+VIOLATES+MASKS     35 edges   0 cycles

The single cycle is dec:an-unplanned-cut-slips-every-later-increment-by-one CAUSES dec:idea-a-planned-increment-is-named-by-content-not-by-number, which OBSOLETES it back — a TIME SEQUENCE rendered as a loop by a projection with no clock, not faulty reasoning. SO THE DESIGN IS STRUCTURALLY CLEAN EVERYWHERE NOBODY WAS LOOKING, which is a result worth having and could not previously be obtained.

AND A SECOND READING THE DESIGN ALREADY ASKED FOR. dec:orientation-is-computed-not-written names the genuinely missing thing as "WHICH FEW DECISIONS SHAPE EVERYTHING ELSE — neither what-next nor where-am-i answers it today, and it is what a newcomer actually needs". Centrality over GOVERNED_BY is that computation and had never been run. Run: the top governors are rule:no-foreclosure, the owner's-word authority rule, a-graph-per-ownership-boundary, systems-are-functional-not-the-file-tree, and the-LLM-speaks-the-graph-remembers-the-human-decides. THE SHAPE MATTERS MORE THAN THE LIST: influence is FLAT, not concentrated — max reach 13, the top five carry 16% of the edges, and 66 of 120 governed nodes are governed by exactly one thing. There is no small set of load-bearing roots. That is evidence against the design being a deep decision tree: a tree has a trunk and this does not.

THE EXCLUSIONS ARE LOAD-BEARING AND THAT WAS PROVEN THE EXPENSIVE WAY. The first centrality run returned garbage — the ten most influential "decisions" were all decision:ack: review records, which structure.rs already excludes from the design network (ver:acknowledgement-not-structure). Excluding them took GOVERNED_BY from 867 edges to 255: TWO THIRDS OF THAT EDGE TYPE IS BOOKKEEPING. A naive run-everything-on-everything gives a confident wrong answer on the first attempt, so any general surface must carry the exclusion list as part of each projection's definition rather than as a caveat.
